select.title: Select a working domain
select.description: Choose a domain you are authorized to work in. Your account's identity domain does not change.
select.identityHelp: Working domains organize projects and access. Your identity domain remains the namespace used to sign in.
select.loadFailed: Authorized domains could not be verified. Selection and creation are unavailable until you retry successfully.
select.switchFailed: The domain switch could not be confirmed. Your current session has not been replaced. Check your access and try again explicitly.
select.created: Created {domain}. Your working domain has not changed. Select Switch domain to enter it.
select.createUncertain: Creation could not be confirmed and will not be repeated. Close this dialog and refresh the domain list before doing anything else; the domain may already exist.
select.createRejected: The server rejected creation. Check the domain name and current permission, then submit again explicitly.
select.createDenied: Your current account policy does not allow domain creation.
select.signupHelp: New users first sign up with email verification from the existing sign-in page, then sign in. Domain creation is available only when their account policy allows it.
select.createHelp: The server rechecks creation permission. Creation does not switch your session; you choose when to enter the new domain.
select.name: Domain name
login.providers.unavailable: Public sign-in providers cannot be discovered right now. Try again shortly.
login.sso.title: Organization SSO
login.sso.help: Choose your organization's sign-in provider. After signing in, choose the domain to access.
login.sso.empty: No SSO sign-in options are available right now.
login.password.invalid: The username or email address, or password, is incorrect.
login.password.forbidden: Your account's home domain sign-in policy does not allow this account to sign in.
login.password.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again shortly.
login.password.unavailable: The authentication service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
login.personalRecovery.retryHelp: Your password was verified, but personal workspace setup stopped safely. Re-enter your password to resume or restart settled setup. Your account and existing resources will not be reset.
login.personalRecovery.operatorHelp: Your password was verified, but a native setup request has an unknown outcome. Ask a system administrator to settle your personal-project operation, then re-enter your password and retry. Retrying cannot repeat an uncertain request or reset your account.
onboarding.personalDeferred: Not created yet. Prepared at the first successful sign-in.
login.sessionMismatch: Sign-in was stopped because the returned account or workspace context was incomplete or invalid.
login.provider.unavailable: This sign-in method is not available right now.
login.provider.invalidUrl: The identity provider address is not safe, so the redirect was stopped.
login.signup.title: Sign up with email verification
login.signup.help: Verify your email to create an account and an automatically named personal project. Administrator approval may be required.
login.signup.sent: If this address can sign up, a verification link has been sent. Check your inbox.
login.signup.failed: The verification link could not be sent. Try again shortly.
login.signup.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
login.signup.notAvailable: Email sign-up is not available for this domain.
callback.invalidRequest: Invalid sign-in response. Sign in again.
callback.providerDenied: Sign-in was not completed at the identity provider.
callback.invalidState: The sign-in request expired or was not started in this browser. Sign in again.
callback.providerChanged: The sign-in method settings changed. Sign in again.
callback.nativeBindingConflict: This external identity is already associated with another account. Contact your administrator.
callback.accountEmailConflict: This verified email belongs to a different account. Contact your administrator.
callback.accountChanged: The account or its email ownership changed. Sign in again to review the current account.
callback.accountAmbiguous: More than one account matches this identity. Contact your administrator.
callback.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
entry.connectDescription: Your verified provider email matches this Accounts account. Connect it to sign in without entering a local password.
entry.createDescription: No Accounts account matches your verified provider email. Create a new Accounts account to continue.
entry.transferExisting: Your existing sign-in connection for this provider will move from the legacy account to this Accounts account. The legacy account, its resources and permissions remain unchanged. The accounts are not merged.
callback.emailNotVerified: A verified email address at the identity provider is required.
callback.emailDomainNotAllowed: This domain does not allow sign-in with that email address.
callback.foreignDomain: The account and domain do not match.
callback.providerDisabled: This sign-in method has been disabled.
callback.providerError: Could not communicate with the identity provider.
callback.unavailable: The authentication service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
onboarding.name: Username
onboarding.nameHelp: The name you will use to sign in.
onboarding.personalOwnership: Your account identity is separate from your automatically named personal project. Joining an organization does not move your account or grant organization ownership.
onboarding.joinedDomainHelp: The new account receives a personal project and joins {domain} with Default reader access. Its sign-in identity remains separate.
onboarding.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
onboarding.invalidInput: Check the username and password requirements.
onboarding.usernameUnavailable: This username is unavailable. Choose another username and enter your password again.
onboarding.accountExists: An account for this email already exists. Sign in with that account.
onboarding.linkInvalid: This link is invalid, already used or expired.
onboarding.unavailable: The request cannot be processed right now. Try again shortly.
onboarding.failed: The request could not be completed.
onboarding.created.title: Account created
onboarding.created.body: Your personal project {project} is ready. Sign in with your username or email.
invitation.title: Domain invitation
invitation.gone: This invitation was already used, has expired or was revoked.
invitation.existingPrompt: Already have an account? Sign in with its username or email.
invitation.emailMismatch: This invitation cannot be accepted because your account email differs from the invited address.
invitation.accepted.title: Invitation accepted
invitation.accepted.body: You can now work in the {domain} domain.
registration.title: Complete email sign-up
registration.description: Verify your email, then choose a username and password. A personal project is named automatically. Joining an organization requires an invitation.
noProject.description: You do not have access to any project in the {domain} domain yet. Ask your domain administrator for project membership.
noProject.descriptionNoDomain: You do not have access to any project yet. Ask your domain administrator for project membership.
signup.description: Verify your email, then choose a username and password. A personal project is named automatically. Joining an organization requires an invitation.
signup.approval.emailPending: Your sign-up is awaiting administrator approval. This request has not created an account or signed you in. After approval, start again with a new email verification link; do not reuse this link.
signup.approval.emailRejected: An administrator has rejected your sign-up. This request has not created an account or signed you in. Contact your administrator for guidance.
signup.approval.providerPending: Your sign-up is awaiting administrator approval. You have not been signed in. After approval, return to sign-in and start a new provider login. This provider response will not be retried.
signup.approval.providerRejected: An administrator has rejected your sign-up. You have not been signed in. Contact your administrator for guidance. This provider response will not be retried.
signup.approval.invitationPending: Your new account needs administrator approval before this invitation can be accepted. No account was created. After approval, follow the notification email: use its new verification link or reopen this invitation as instructed. Public email registration may be disabled.
signup.approval.invitationRejected: An administrator has rejected your sign-up. No account was created and this invitation was not accepted. Contact your administrator for guidance.
signup.existing: Sign in with your original account. A pending invitation can then be connected. If you forgot your username or password, use account recovery.
recovery.title: Recover account
recovery.description: Request a one-use link at your account email. You do not need to know your domain name.
recovery.sent: If this address is eligible, an email has been sent. Check your inbox.
recovery.notAvailable: Email requests are not currently available. Contact your administrator or try again later.
recovery.usernameResult: This verification link has been used. Sign in with your original username and domain below. Reopening the link will not reveal them again.
recovery.changed: The change is complete. Existing sessions have been revoked; sign in again.
emailChange.help: Prove your account with your current password, then approve the link in the new inbox. Your account email stays unchanged until verified.
emailChange.sent: A verification link was sent to the new inbox. Approve it there; your account email has not changed yet.
emailChange.failed: The email change could not be requested. Check your current password and address. External-only accounts are not supported.
emailChange.confirm: Change the account email to this address? Confirming revokes existing sessions.
link.title: Connect your existing account
link.description: An account with this email already exists. Prove ownership using its original username and password to connect this provider. Your original password will not change. Sign in again after connecting.
link.complete: The external login is connected. Sign in again to enter the {domain} domain.
recovery.failed: The result could not be confirmed. This account may not support this recovery method, or the link may already be used. The request will not be repeated automatically. Request a new link or contact your administrator.
link.authenticatedHelp: For an external-only account, approve with the already signed-in original account session. The server verifies that it is the same account.
